sentences.en: In his fantasy, he imagined he was a famous writer.
sentences.zh: 在他的幻想中，他想象自己是一位著名的作家。

sentences.en: Natsume Soseki is one of the best writers in Japan.
sentences.zh: 夏目漱石是日本最好的作家之一。

sentences.en: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.
sentences.zh: 每一个伟大的作家似乎都对英语感兴趣。

senses.zh: 作家, 作者, 著者, 写…的人
